title: OpenAI Just Put Codex Inside Claude Code
description:
OpenAI publishes an official Claude Code plugin that runs Codex in the same terminal. It adds eight slash commands including a read-only code review and an adversarial review, plus a rescue subagent. This short covers what it actually does, the real four-command setup, and the honest cost picture.

Covered: the three workflows worth using (plan and build handoff, second-opinion review before you ship, and a bounded debate between the two models), plus why it does not reduce your total spend.

Get the full setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1eDaGH8q4smp5y9lPk1X1Dm6onUPZHOQOuEnm-EPsvMA/edit?usp=sharing
